title: Hoka Bondi 9 Mens Road Running Shoes - Colour Black+Black $179.99 Delivered @ Wild Earth
body:
Deal: Hoka Bondi 9 Mens Road Running Shoes - Colour Black+Black $179.99 Delivered @ Wild Earth

[RedFoxAU] Don't mind the Hoka, will be my third of the 9s and also have 1x Bondi 10s.
All are great, daily driver - every ~18m pick up a deal like this. Thanks!
[Ten] Use code GETWILDER for an additional 5% off
[hypanthium] The shoe equivalent of a bus without power steering.
[Pennywisepound12] For others who are also cursed with wide feet, this shoe will be a terrible fit. The toebox is very narrow and it has a sharp taper.
The 4e version of this on the other hand is fantastic. Probably the most comfy shoes ive ever worn.
[shmahoo] https://www.wildearth.com.au/buy/hoka-bondi-9-mens-wide-road…
would this be wide enough for you?
[eug] Nope, that's only 2E. The 4E version is Extra Wide which far fewer shops sell.
[Pennywisepound12] I appreciate the link 🙂
But, unfortunately only the x-wide (4e) version fits me. Those rarely go on sale, but I recently managed to get 2 from the running warehouse for $199 each.
They should keep me going for a while :)
[pplovers] my feet arent that wide but the normal version was still too narrow for me, crazy
[CBrads4] I personally prefer the 1080, they’re my go-to shoe for long runs. I had a pair of the Bondi 9s and I ended up removing them from my shoe rotation after about 60kms. I’ve put ~250kms on my 1080s and have absolutely zero regrets, they still feel great.
[Jdiggitywap] Great deal picked up a 2nd pair thanks OP
[ACLmyon] Thanks OP, bought a backup pair.
For those who are wondering, the Wide version is available too.
[dontcrash] plenty of great last gen shoes at this price mark
[Mums Poop Sock] "Bondi 9 delivers peak plushness"
Hard disagree. The shoe is thick but not soft or plush.
